results.title: Chef Damu dies at 72: Sanjeev Kapoor, Thalapathy Vijay pay tribute to Cooku with Comali judge
results.description: Damodaran Kothandaraman, popularly known as Chef Damu, has died at the age of 72. The Padma Shri recipient, who became a familiar face on Tamil television as a judge on the cooking reality show Cooku with Comali, once set a Guinness World Record by preparing 617 dishes in a single cooking marathon. Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay and celebrity chef Sanjeev Kapoor have paid tribute to him.

results.title: Jennifer Peedom On Tenzing, Mount Everest, And The Sherpa Community’s Unsung Contributions
results.description: What makes Mount Everest exert such a powerful hold on our collective imagination? In a virtual roundtable, Jennifer Peedom discusses the central significance of Tenzing Norgay’s journey and why his story remains so relevant and inspiring.

results.title: Cameron Green Set to Make Comeback in Decisive Test Against South Africa
results.description: Cameron Green is poised to make his return for Australia in the crucial third Test against South Africa, following a swift recovery from an abdominal injury. The series stands at 1-1, with both teams eager to claim victory. Green reflects on his injury's unusual nature and his experiences facing South Africa's formidable bowling attack. His recent performance against Bangladesh showcases his potential impact in the upcoming match. As the final Test approaches, fans are eager to see how Green's presence will influence the outcome of the series.
